prompt.placeholder: Describe your idea, we’ll make the video.
prompt.more_detail: A bit more detail helps us create something great — add a few more words.
prompt.start_error: There was a problem starting your generation. Please try again.
questions.title: Questions
questions.submit_error: Could not submit your answers. Please try again.
create.title: New video
create.placeholder: Describe your video. For example: how bees make honey, explained for kids.
create.example1: How bees make honey, explained for kids
create.example2: A calm one-minute story about a lighthouse keeper
create.example3: How a bank loan works, in plain words
create.example4: The history of the bicycle in two minutes
create.fourk_slower: It also takes longer to make, and the file is bigger.
create.not_enough: This video needs {needed} credits and you have {balance}.
create.paused_fallback: Creating videos is paused for this account for now.
create.blocked_fallback: We can’t make this video. If you had another idea in mind, try describing a different one.
create.unsupported_fallback: This request is outside what videomk can make. Try describing the topic in a different way.
deck.add_sub: Turn your slides into a narrated video.
deck.limits: PowerPoint (.pptx) or PDF, up to {mb} MB and {slides} slides.
deck.limits_pdf_only: PDF, up to {mb} MB and {slides} slides.
deck.limits_pptx_only: PowerPoint (.pptx), up to {mb} MB and {slides} slides.
deck.drop_label: Add a presentation. Drop a file here, or press Enter to choose one.
deck.processing_body: This takes about half a minute. You can wait here.
deck.promise: We'll explain every slide: yours stay exactly as you designed them, and a narrator walks through each one.
deck.length_hint: The length we suggest is about 20 seconds per slide. You can change it.
deck.placeholder: Optional. Who is it for? For example: for executives, or for students.
deck.vertical_warn: Slides are wide. In this format they appear smaller, with blurred space around them. Landscape fits them best.
deck.submit_hint: Nothing is charged until you create the video.
deck.err.title: We couldn't use this presentation
deck.err.too_large: This file is bigger than {mb} MB. Save a smaller copy, for example by compressing the pictures, and try again.
deck.err.too_many_slides: This presentation has more than {slides} slides. Split it into shorter parts and add one at a time.
deck.err.encrypted: This file is protected with a password, so we can't open it. Save a copy without a password and add that one.
deck.err.macro: This file contains macros or embedded programs, which we never open. Save a copy as a plain .pptx or export it as PDF.
deck.err.corrupt: We couldn't read this file. It may be damaged. Open it, save a copy or export it as PDF, and add that.
deck.err.empty: We found no slides to show in this file. Check that it has at least one slide and add it again.
deck.err.unsafe: We can't use this file. Export your slides as PDF and add that instead.
deck.err.convert: We couldn't prepare your slides this time. Try again, or export them as PDF first.
deck.err.unsupported: We can use PowerPoint (.pptx) and PDF files. Export your presentation in one of those formats.
deck.err.export_first: We can't use this format directly. In PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides, export the presentation as .pptx or PDF and add that file.
deck.err.too_many_decks: You have added many presentations today. Please try again tomorrow.
deck.err.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Your slides may still be on their way.
deck.err.upload_failed: The upload didn't finish. Check your connection and try again.
deck.err.unavailable: Presentations aren't available right now. Please try again later.
deck.err.network: We couldn't reach videomk. Check your connection and try again.
deck.err.expired: That presentation is no longer available. Add it again.
